english.note: 手錶 is the all-purpose noun for a portable or wearable timepiece.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a watch worn on the wrist.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zek3 san1 sau2 biu1

examples.english: I forgot to put on my wristwatch, so I don't know what time it is.
examples.traditional: 我唔記得戴手錶，唔知而家幾點。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 sau2 biu1 m4 zi1 ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2
